card.name: Table footnote letters after doses
card.fires_on: A lone lowercase footnote letter (a, b, c, q) right after a dose, drug name or abbreviation in a table. It also fires on the q in dosing intervals such as q4wks.

modes.label: Footnote letter in dose tables
modes.description: A single letter marker follows a dose or volume in a dosing table.
modes.example: Darunavir oral suspension 4 mL<< b>> (385 mg) with rit

modes.label: Footnote letter after drug or lab term
modes.description: A letter marker follows a drug name or genotype in an interaction table or a stopping rule.
modes.example: Eliglustat CYP2D6 EMs c taking a strong or moderate CYP2D6 inhibitor, CYP2D6 IMs<< c>> , or CYP2D6 PM

modes.label: Interval letter q
modes.description: The q or Q of a dosing interval inside parentheses.
